summary: Connected dated user-CSV calibration to the correlated four-asset option-book engine while preserving legacy defaults. Added frozen, spot-matched and fitted comparisons with parameter snapshots, cutoff provenance, common shocks and twelve paired Sobol scrambles. The studio exposes actual results from a generated synthetic fixture; no market observations are bundled. Calibrated VaR is 243.98 USD versus 333.05 USD at matched spots, a sensitivity result rather than an accuracy claim. Fifteen tests pass and four studio cases reproduce.
